title_original: ‘Focker-In-Law’ Red Carpet Premiere Photos: Ariana Grande, Ben Stiller, Skyler Gisondo, Owen Wilson & More

blocks.text: The stars of Focker-in-Law reunited at the Beacon Theatre in New York City to celebrate its world premiere.
Ariana Grande, Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson, Robert De Niro, and Blythe Danner star in the comedy film written and directed by John Hamburg, based on a story by Hamburg, Ilana Glazer, and Austen Earl.
The fourth installment of the Fockers franchise also stars Teri Polo, Skyler Gisondo, Beanie Feldstein and Eduardo Franco.

blocks.text: Still operating as a helicopter parent to his two adult kids, Greg Focker’s (Stiller) anxieties spiral out of control when his son Henry (Superman’s Skyler Gisondo) brings home a formidable new girlfriend, Olivia (Grande), to celebrate the 80th birthday of Greg’s still-intimidating father-in-law, Jack Byrnes (De Niro).

Greg’s concerns skyrocket when Olivia is embraced by everyone, including Jack, and Henry reveals that he plans to propose. Certain that Olivia is hiding something, Greg attempts to unmask her, leading to a calamitous weekend that sees the rivalry between the two future in-laws escalate from an airplane to the kitchen to the bike path.

blocks.text: The executive producers for Focker-in-Law include Nancy Tenenbaum, Amy Herman, Lauren Hennessey, Michelle Graham, and Berry Welsh. Universal Pictures and Paramount Pictures present a Tribeca/Red Hour/Delirious Media/Particular Pictures production of a John Hamburg film.
Focker-in-Law opens in theaters on November 25.
